meta.status: DRAFT design only, not in game
meta.note: NEW creatures for regions 6-8; not DEX_450 entries; dex_no provisional

creatures.name: Puffgill
creatures.visual_brief: Round baby sea-robin fish with fan-like pectoral 'wings' it flaps on sand; big glossy eyes, pink belly. Palette: coral pink, sand, teal, violet. Crystal: small violet crystal on its brow.
creatures.flavour: Hops along the tideline on its fins and sulks when a wave knocks it over.

creatures.name: Kelpkit
creatures.visual_brief: Sea-otter kit wrapped in a kelp blanket like a scarf, holding a tiny shell; floats belly-up. Palette: cocoa brown, kelp green, cream, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the shell it holds.
creatures.flavour: Ties itself to kelp so it does not drift away while it naps.

creatures.name: Drizzlop
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby storm-petrel chick, grey down puffed like a raincloud, little webbed feet; a drip hangs off its beak. Palette: storm grey, white, slate blue, violet. Crystal: violet crystal tuft on its head.
creatures.flavour: Only sings when it rains, then sings all night.

creatures.name: Cocklet
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny hermit-snail creature living in a ribbed cockle shell, two stalk eyes and a soft peach body. Palette: peach, cream shell, rose, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the shell's hinge.
creatures.flavour: Swaps shells with friends as a sign of trust.

creatures.name: Foamfawn
creatures.visual_brief: Small sea-spray fawn with a seafoam mane and frothy tail, hooves leave bubbles. Palette: aqua, white foam, pale gold, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Seen only where waves hit the rocks hardest, playing in the spray.

creatures.name: Nubbinray
creatures.visual_brief: Pocket-sized round ray, smiling underside, freckled back, stubby tail with a bow-like fin. Palette: dusty blue, pale cream, navy freckles, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Glides in rock pools and lets children stroke its back.

creatures.name: Shoalpup
creatures.visual_brief: Harbour-seal pup with barnacle-studded flippers and a rope-knot collar pattern. Palette: speckled grey, cream, rope tan, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its collar.
creatures.flavour: Barks at boats until someone throws it a fish.

creatures.name: Swellhound
creatures.visual_brief: Lean adolescent sea-lion hound, long neck and powerful fore-flippers, barnacle crust spreading into shoulder pads, rope-knot pattern now a thick ruff. Palette: speckled grey, cream, rope tan, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its ruff.
creatures.flavour: Guards one stretch of pier and barks the tide in and out.

creatures.name: Breakwarden
creatures.visual_brief: Massive walrus-like guardian with basalt-plate shoulders like a sea wall, two long coral tusks. Palette: slate grey, coral red, foam white, violet. Crystal: violet crystal clusters on the shoulder plates.
creatures.flavour: Lies across harbour mouths during storms so the waves break on it instead of the boats.

creatures.name: Galecrest
creatures.visual_brief: Slim sea-wyvern with wing-like flipper fins, a forked tail fin and a white wind-blown crest like breaking surf. Palette: teal, cream, white, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at the base of its crest.
creatures.flavour: Rides storm fronts from coast to coast and is always the first to sense one coming.

creatures.name: Undertusk
creatures.visual_brief: Deep-water narwhal-eel hybrid with a spiral tusk of dark nacre and glowing bioluminescent side dots. Palette: abyss navy, pearl, cyan glow, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at the tusk base.
creatures.flavour: Surfaces in the sea cave once a season; fishermen leave the cave quiet that night.

creatures.name: Wickmote
creatures.visual_brief: Little candle-stub creature with a soft wax body, a dripping topknot and a calm flame halo. Palette: cream wax, warm amber, soft orange, violet. Crystal: violet crystal set in its wax chest.
creatures.flavour: Sits in empty windows so homes never look dark.

creatures.name: Fogkin
creatures.visual_brief: Puff of harbour fog with round eyes and two little mitten-arms, trailing wisps. Palette: pale grey, mist blue, white, violet. Crystal: violet crystal floating in its middle.
creatures.flavour: Follows lost sailors home, then vanishes when they open the door.

creatures.name: Paperpaw
creatures.visual_brief: Folded-paper lantern kitten, pleated body glowing from inside, tassel tail. Palette: rice-paper white, red trim, warm glow, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its tassel.
creatures.flavour: Floats on festival nights and naps folded flat by day.

creatures.name: Lensmoth
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy round moth with lace-pattern wings that shine like a lamp's lens, feathery antennae. Palette: ivory, honey, dusk blue, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its fuzzy chest.
creatures.flavour: Collects at lighthouse windows; keepers count them to guess the weather.

creatures.name: Bellbuoy
creatures.visual_brief: Round little buoy-bodied creature with a tiny bell for a tail and stubby legs, red and white stripes. Palette: buoy red, white, brass, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its top cap.
creatures.flavour: Rings gently when a ship is near the rocks.

creatures.name: Hushlet
creatures.visual_brief: Puffball owlet with a lantern-glass eye ring and silent fringed feathers, half see-through. Palette: smoke grey, pale lilac, amber eyes, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Never makes a sound; you only know it is there when the lamps flicker.

creatures.name: Lampwisp
creatures.visual_brief: Hollow ship-lantern with a ghostly flame face inside and a chain handle like a tail. Palette: tarnished brass, teal flame, dark iron, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the lantern's peak.
creatures.flavour: Swings in the wind on the docks long after the ships have gone.

creatures.name: Lanternshade
creatures.visual_brief: Small hooded wisp-spirit with a ragged teal-grey cloak and two thin arms, carrying its old brass lantern like a heart in its chest; teal flame eyes. Palette: tarnished brass, teal flame, slate, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its hood tip.
creatures.flavour: Walks the docks at night checking every mooring rope.

creatures.name: Beaconwraith
creatures.visual_brief: Tall floating wraith with a long tattered sail-cloth robe and wide sleeve-wings; a caged brass beacon lantern glows teal in its chest and casts a beam from its eyes; antler-like brass crown. Palette: brass, slate, teal beam, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at the heart of the lamp.
creatures.flavour: Its beam shows the safe way in, but only to those who mean the harbour no harm.

creatures.name: Tidelore
creatures.visual_brief: Old sea-turtle sage with a chart-map shell and barnacle spectacles, a scroll of tide tables on its back. Palette: sea green, parchment, brass, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the shell's top.
creatures.flavour: Remembers every ship that ever sailed from Lanternport.

creatures.name: Veilfin
creatures.visual_brief: Large ghost-fish with veil fins like curtains of light that swims through the air at night. Palette: midnight, pale aqua, silver, violet. Crystal: violet crystal behind its eyes.
creatures.flavour: Said to carry home the lights of ships that never came back.

creatures.name: Ashbun
creatures.visual_brief: Rabbit kit with ash-grey fluff and ember-tipped ears that glow when it is happy. Palette: ash grey, ember orange, charcoal, violet. Crystal: violet crystal between its ears.
creatures.flavour: Dust-bathes in warm ash and sneezes little sparks.

creatures.name: Pumicub
creatures.visual_brief: Round bear cub made of light pumice stone, holes all over, floats in hot springs. Palette: pumice beige, warm grey, lava orange, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its tummy.
creatures.flavour: Bobs in the hot springs and refuses to get out.

creatures.name: Emberkip
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy chick whose down is soft flame-orange, tiny coal beak, tail like a struck match. Palette: flame orange, yellow, soot black, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its head tuft.
creatures.flavour: Warms eggs in cold nests for any bird that asks.

creatures.name: Flarekite
creatures.visual_brief: Young firebird with a slim kite-like body, flame-orange and yellow feathers, soot-black wingtips, coal-black beak and two long ribbon tail streamers with match-head tips; flame crest. Palette: flame orange, yellow, soot black, violet. Crystal: violet crystal in its flame crest.
creatures.flavour: Rides the hot updrafts over the lava fields, practising dives it is not ready for.

creatures.name: Pyrevane
creatures.visual_brief: Majestic firebird perched on charred basalt, broad wings raised in a crescent like a weathervane, layered orange, gold and ember-red feathers edged in soot black, long ember-curl tail fan, crown of swept-back flame plumes. Palette: flame orange, gold, ember red, soot black, violet. Crystal: violet crystal cradled in its flame crown.
creatures.flavour: Turns on the caldera rim to face the wind; old miners read its heading like a weathervane before a flare-up.

creatures.name: Smoglet
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby velvet mole pup, soot black with big pink digging paws, a glowing ember-red nose and smoke curling off its back. Palette: soot black, pink, ember red, smoke grey, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on top of its head.
creatures.flavour: Tunnels up through warm chimneys and pops out covered in soot.

creatures.name: Geysquirt
creatures.visual_brief: Small long-tailed newt with a blowhole on its back that puffs steam, cream mineral-crust spots. Palette: terracotta, clay red, cream, steam white, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its tail.
creatures.flavour: Spouts steam to say hello and to say goodbye.

creatures.name: Cinderpip
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny armadillo with cooled-lava shell bands showing glowing cracks, curls into a warm ball. Palette: basalt black, lava glow, rust, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at the shell peak.
creatures.flavour: Miners carry one in winter as a hand warmer.

creatures.name: Forgehorn
creatures.visual_brief: Young ox with a glowing iron-ore horn and slag-crusted flanks, sparks at its hooves. Palette: iron grey, molten orange, rust, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its brow.
creatures.flavour: Butts rocks to test them, then eats the ones with ore inside.

creatures.name: Smeltbull
creatures.visual_brief: Muscular young bull with two curved ore horns glowing at the tips, slag-plate shoulders with lava seams, bellows-like nostrils puffing sparks. Palette: iron grey, molten orange, rust, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its brow plate.
creatures.flavour: Snorts sparks into ore seams to soften the rock before it digs.

creatures.name: Anvilaurox
creatures.visual_brief: Towering aurochs with an anvil-flat skull plate, lava channels running down its back like a forge's gutters. Palette: blackened iron, molten orange, ash, violet. Crystal: violet crystal clusters along the spine.
creatures.flavour: Smiths say the best blades were hammered on its back while it slept.

creatures.name: Slagdrake
creatures.visual_brief: Low wingless drake with crusted slag scales and a plume of dark smoke for a mane. Palette: charcoal, ember red, smoke purple-grey, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its chest.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps in cooling lava flows and wakes in a bad mood.

creatures.name: Calderune
creatures.visual_brief: Ancient stone serpent-turtle whose shell is a small crater with a lava pool; rune-cut plates glow. Palette: obsidian, magma gold, ash, violet. Crystal: violet crystal standing in the crater pool.
creatures.flavour: When it stirs, the whole vale feels warm for a week.
